description: Enigma Robes Level 60 Bring the Husk of the Old God, 2 Idols of the Sun, 5 Gold Scarabs and 5 Clay Scarabs to Vethsera inside Ahn'Qiraj. You must also attain Honored reputation with the Brood of Nozdormu to complete this quest.
